jobs.description:
**Company Description**
 Company Description
   

  

 At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content \- wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Job Description
   

  

 Nielsen ONE focuses on the measurement of ads and their outcomes, and empowers advertisers, publishers and agencies with the intelligence they need to drive revenue, increase market share, and optimize their audiences and investments.
   

  

 We are seeking a Lead Product Manager to drive the future of our Nielsen ONE Reporting product vision. In this role, you will be responsible for the Reporting or delivery of results to clients via end user interfaces like dashboards, APIs, and AI integrations for our Ads and Outcomes product suite. You will lead a team of product managers and define the product strategy and roadmap for your pillar and be responsible for defining broad technical product standards and integration frameworks for Dashboard, API, and AI capabilities, keeping Nielsen at the forefront of ad\-tech innovation.
   

  

 You will be looked towards as a Nielsen expert who proactively anticipates business challenges and regulatory adjustments (such as cookie deprecation or clean room compliance) to design flexible, future\-proof reporting architectures that are AI first.
   

  

**What You’ll Do / Responsibilities**
 Product Strategy \& Innovation:
   

  

* Define and own the product vision and roadmap for our Nielsen ONE Reporting strategy, aligning it with business goals and market opportunities.
* Heavily involved in the definition of and delivery against OKRs for the Reporting pillar, securing strategic alignment with senior leadership and cross\-team functions.
* Able to prioritize initiative/feature level roadmaps for entire products/product suites and champion prioritization best practices throughout the organization.
* Maintain an active line of sight for critical dependent reporting workflows needed 1–2 years out, translating the corporate strategic vision into a phased, iterative product roadmap.
* Act as the subject matter expert on our Dashboard, API, and AI Reporting integrations.
* Stay on top of industry trends, competitor movements, and emerging technologies to inform our product decisions


 Execution Leadership
   

  

* From ideation and discovery to feature definition, development, and GTM launch, you will manage the entire product lifecycle.
* Pivotal in ensuring the successful delivery of projects, often acting as the bridge between senior management and operational teams.
* Advocate for scalable solution design that supports end user needs and use cases.
* Mentor, guide, and foster an environment of critical thinking for junior\-to\-mid\-level product managers, empowering them to drive complex initiatives independently.
* Establish high\-quality requirement\-writing blueprints and best practices for the product organization, empowering mid\-level PMs to own independent feature delivery.
* Use data and qualitative feedback to measure product performance and identify opportunities for optimization and improvement.
* Proactively evaluate technical and cross\-project dependencies, calculating risk impacts and instituting concrete mitigation frameworks to safe\-guard product deliveries through General Availability (GA).
* Effectively communicate clear, high\-stakes narratives regarding reporting vision, priorities, and trade\-offs to senior leadership (VP/SVP track) and key client executives.


**Qualifications**
 Qualifications
   

  

* 12–15\+ years in product management (or 15–20 years of total relevant industry experience), with an established track record of launching top\-tier enterprise SaaS capabilities in the ad\-tech or media ecosystem
* A top\-tier expertise of the ad measurement ecosystem, including end user interfaces (dashboards) , APIs, and AI integrations
* A proven track record of successfully launching and scaling complex products in a fast\-paced environment.
* Expert communicator, both written \& verbal, across levels \& functions, with the ability to clearly articulate vision \& priorities so stakeholders know what, why, \& when.
* A strategic thinker who assesses risk, both likelihood and impact, in order to account for potential positive and negative outcomes with mitigation steps.
* High\-level problem\-solving abilities, drawing assumptions where necessary and anticipating business challenges and regulatory issues.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience; advanced degree or specialized ad\-tech/product management certifications preferred.


**Additional Information**
 Additional information

Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Job Title: Product Manager \- Digital Experience \& Growth
   

  

 The Digital Growth Product Team is the engine driving our digital channels. We are looking for a strategic Product Manager to bridge the gap between a magical digital storefront and a scalable web infrastructure. You will own the "Discovery\-to\-Lead" journey, ensuring our brand is showcased beautifully, traffic is acquired efficiently through cutting\-edge search strategies, and our web platforms scale seamlessly to create a world\-class digital experience for Ather.
   

  

**About The Role**
* You’ll be our: Product Manager
* You’ll be based at: IBC Knowledge Park, Bengaluru
* You’ll be Aligned with: Senior Product Manager \- Software Products
* You’ll be a member of: Product Management Team


 What you’ll do:
   

  

* Brand \& Design Collaboration: Partner closely with our Brand and UX Design teams to translate Ather’s premium visual identity into an intuitive, high\-converting digital storefront. You will ensure the website beautifully and accurately showcases our product information, engineering stories, and brand philosophy.
* Traffic Growth \& Discovery (SEO/AEO): Own top\-of\-funnel organic acquisition. Design and execute advanced Search Engine Optimization (SEO) and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) strategies to ensure Ather is the definitive answer across traditional search engines and emerging AI/LLM discovery platforms.
* Infrastructure Excellence (CMS \& Design System): Build for efficiency. Develop and scale our Content Management System (CMS) to empower marketing teams to deploy content faster. Collaborate with design and engineering to build a unified Digital Design System, reducing code duplication and accelerating time\-to\-market.
* Conversion Optimization: Conduct deep\-dive funnel analysis and continuous A/B testing on landing pages and web flows to ruthlessly optimize the traffic\-to\-lead conversion rate, test\-ride bookings, and pre\-orders.
* Full\-Funnel Alignment: Manage the integration between the web storefront and backend lead\-capture engines. Ensure high availability, performance optimization (page load speeds), and clean user routing.
* Reporting \& Analytics: Define and track North Star metrics like Monthly Active Users (MAU), Organic Traffic Growth, Bounce Rates, and Form Submission Conversion Rates. Maintain robust event tracking to identify drop\-off bottlenecks.


 Here’s what we are looking for:
   

  

* Technical \& Domain Depth: Minimum 2 years of experience owning consumer\-facing web products or growth funnels. A strong grasp of headless CMS architecture, SEO/AEO frameworks, and web performance optimization techniques techniques is highly preferred.
* Execution Focus: Proven ability to write detailed PRDs for both front\-end UI enhancements and complex back\-end integrations. Proficiency in SQL and working with web analytics tools (GA4\) is a must.
* Business Acumen \& Hustle: A clear thinker who understands the "why" behind user behavior data. Ability to solve ambiguous growth and visibility problems using data, innovation, and cross\-functional stakeholder alignment.
* Design Sensibility: A keen eye for UI/UX, micro\-interactions, and visual storytelling. You have a high bar for design and love working closely with creative teams to build premium B2C interfaces.
* Other Skills: Strong organizational and time\-management skills, with the ability to prioritize a high\-volume experiment backlog and meet deadlines. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across Brand, Marketing, and Engineering teams. A proactive attitude and willingness to learn and adapt to new challenges.


 You bring to us:
   

  

* Experience: 4–7 years of total experience in Product Management.
* Background: A proven track record in a high\-growth D2C, E\-commerce, or consumer\-tech environment owning web products.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering is required. An MBA (Tier\-1\) is a plus but not mandatory.


**Want to know more?**
 At Ather, we’ve built India’s first intelligent scooter, from scratch. Based on the philosophy of clean design and smart technology, we are transforming the urban commute experience. We are expanding in India, and in the coming years, we look forward to scaling up and launching more products globally. Today, our product offerings include the Ather 450X, 450S, 450 Apex, and Rizta. Beyond the product, we are also setting up an extensive charging network and re\-imagining end\-to\-end ownership experience. To know more, check out our Careers site and our Substack.
   

  

**Be You, With Us**
 The Ather story doesn't write itself \- our people do. We believe everyone is equal, but not the same. Diversity is our strength, and building an inclusive and equitable workplace begins with acknowledging and embracing our differences. We are an equal opportunity employer, and our team reflects a wide range of identities, experiences, and perspectives \- all united by a shared passion to shape the Ather journey.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About SpotDraft.**
 SpotDraft is on a mission to help legal and business teams move faster, together. Our AI\-powered contracting platform is redefining how companies manage contracts, and our story deserves to be told in creative, human, and memorable ways.
   

  

**Top Outcomes:**
 Senior Product Managers own a product area's outcomes. You operate independently within team goals, are given white space to set the why and frame the what and how, and are trusted to decide your area's roadmap, prioritisation, and the outcomes it commits to. You carry influence across pods and with external stakeholders.
   

  

 We grade outcomes, not output. A shipped feature is necessary but never sufficient. The bar is the change it causes against a stated hypothesis: adoption, a behaviour, or a number that moves.
   

  

**Day to Day:**
* Be the authority on your area's customers. Run discovery directly, own win/loss for your area, and keep its top churn and loss drivers visible in the org's priorities. Resolve discovery into a crisp persona and value proposition for what gets built.
* Own the area roadmap and prioritisation. Maintain one ranked backlog sized by quantified demand. Make the business\-value case and name the opportunity cost for every proposal, and decline off\-ICP work with reasoning. Be the team's authority on your market: competitors, category trajectory, analyst and buyer signals.
* Envision how AI evolves the workflow. Evaluate every initiative for how AI can enhance, evolve, or fundamentally reinvent the way the work gets done, not just bolt onto it. SpotDraft is an AI\-native product, so this is core craft. Ship AI where it wins.
* Use analytics to predict and track behaviour. Have a clear understanding of how analytics are used to predict and track user behaviour, instrument your area against an adoption baseline, and feed that understanding directly into the product roadmap. Every initiative carries a hypothesis, a confidence level, and a named falsifier.
* De\-risk early. Write the problem before the spec. Pre\-mortem every committed bet, name the riskiest assumption, and run the cheapest test before build. Carry leading and lagging indicators for your value metric.
* Drive iterative delivery. Ship a potentially shippable increment each sprint, each advancing a stated outcome or learning, with the right speed and quality trade\-offs and a short time to first validate learning.
* Be a champion of clarity. Produce a source\-of\-truth brief and enablement for major GA releases, pre\-address stakeholder feedback, and run no surprise releases. Every partner function signs off that it has what it needs.


**Close collaboration is a must**
 You will work hand in hand with Development, QA, and Design through the entire build, alongside Legal Tech, PMM, Sales, SE, and Customer Success. Tight, continuous partnership with Dev, QA, and Design is non\-negotiable.
   

  

**Requirements:**
* 5\-7 years of relevant product management experience in a B2B SaaS product company, with a track record of shipping high\-impact products that moved a business outcome, not just a feature list.
* Outcome ownership at area scope. You have owned a product area or major surface end to end, set its direction from a goal, and been the person other pods consult on it.
* Evidence\-driven judgement. You instrument what you build, state confidence with support, and change your plan when the data disconfirms it. You can analyse and synthesise data, including writing SQL, and are fluent with analytics tools (Amplitude, Metabase, Google Analytics, or equivalents).
* Customer fluency. You empathise across many personas and use cases and can articulate who a product is for and the value it claims in the customer's terms.
* AI fluency in your own workflow. You use AI to compress your largest time costs, which is the prerequisite for evaluating AI well in the product.
* Strong written and verbal communication, with a knack for articulating customer challenges clearly and a good understanding of UX design practices in SaaS.
* Bias for action and comfort with ambiguity, owning initiatives end to end in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.


**Why SpotDraft?**
* Brilliant teammates—Work with some of the sharpest minds in legal tech.
* Expand your network—Interact with top founders, investors, and industry leaders.
* Real impact—Take ownership of projects and see your work in action.
* Big goals, bold moves—We trust you to deliver, innovate, and push boundaries.


**Our Core Values**
* Our business is to delight Customers
* Be Transparent. Be Direct
* Be Audacious
* Outcomes over everything else
* Elevate each other
* Be Passionate. Take Ownership.
* Be 1% better every day


**All candidates’ personal data shared during the recruitment process will be handled with utmost confidentiality and used solely for hiring purposes, in line with applicable data protection regulations.**
* SpotDraft is an equal\-opportunity employer. Candidates will not be discriminated against based on race, ethnicity, color, religion, caste, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, veteran, or disability status

jobs.description:
**About the role:**

  

As a Product Technical Specialist, you will be the trusted technical expert for our customers, ensuring they have a seamless and reliable experience with our SaaS platform. This role is for a natural problem\-solver who thrives on diving deep into complex technical issues. You will be the backbone of our support operations, diagnosing and resolving intricate problems related to our AWS\-hosted environment, networking configurations, and integrated phone systems. You are energized by a fast\-paced environment and are passionate about providing world\-class support through phone, email, and chat, ready to tackle any challenge that comes your way, including participation in a rotating on\-call schedule to provide critical support.

 **Role \& Responsibilities:**


* Provide high\-quality, real\-time technical support to customers via phone, email, and chat, managing multiple issues simultaneously.
* Lead technical troubleshooting sessions with customer IT teams, diagnosing and resolving complex issues related to networking (VPNs, firewalls, whitelisting), cloud infrastructure (AWS), and integrated phone systems.
* Utilize Zendesk to manage, prioritize, and document customer support tickets from initial contact through to resolution.
* Analyze application and server logs to identify bugs, performance bottlenecks, and the root cause of failures.
* Collaborate directly with Engineering teams to escalate and resolve deep technical issues, acting as the customer advocate.
* Participate in a rotating on\-call schedule to provide after\-hours and weekend support for critical, service\-impacting incidents.
* Develop and maintain internal and customer\-facing support documentation, including knowledge base articles and troubleshooting guides.
* Proactively identify opportunities for product improvements and process enhancements to reduce support ticket volume and improve the customer experience.
* Mentor junior team members on best practices for ticket handling and technical diagnosis.

  


**Qualifications:**


* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 4\+ years of experience in a technical support role for an Enterprise SaaS product.

  


**Technical Proficiency:**


* Strong hands\-on experience with Zendesk for ticketing and customer support.
* Deep understanding of networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, VPNs, firewalls, and protocols like SFTP and HTTPS.
* Proven experience working with cloud environments, specifically Amazon Web Services (AWS) (e.g., EC2, S3, VPC).
* Familiarity with troubleshooting VoIP/telephony systems and understanding common issues.

  


**Core Skills:**


* Exceptional critical thinking and problem\-solving abilities with a passion for tackling complex technical challenges.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage high\-priority tasks, and perform effectively under pressure.
* Experience with log analysis tools (e.g., Kibana, CloudWatch) and network traffic analysis tools (e.g., Fiddler, Wireshark).
* Ability to remain organized and detail\-oriented while managing a high volume of support interactions.
* Must be willing and able to participate in a rotating on\-call schedule**.**

* Be part of a dynamic, high\-growth tech company with an exciting future.
* Work in a collaborative and supportive environment that values innovation and employee experience.
* Competitive compensation and benefits, including healthcare, 401(k), and professional development opportunities.
* An opportunity to make a direct impact in shaping peoples direct access to financial services by enabling community financial institutions to efficiently communicate with their membership base.

CFIs (Community Banks and Credit Unions) use Eltropy to communicate with consumers via Text, Video, Secure Chat, co\-browsing, screen sharing and chatbot technology — all integrated in a single platform bolstered by AI, skill\-based routing and other contact center capabilities.

**Description**
 As a Senior Product Manager / Head of Gamified Experiences on Amazon, you will own the product vision and execution roadmap for our Gamified Experiences charter. This charter sits at the intersection of behavioral science, game mechanics, and customer lifecycle strategy \- and is responsible for designing and scaling engagement systems that transform occasional buyers into deeply settled customers across our emerging locales.
   

  

 You will lead the end\-to\-end product strategy for milestone\-based rewards, missions, challenges, and progression systems that drive measurable increases in purchase frequency, selection width, and customer retention.
   

  

 Your systems will determine which gamified intervention to present, to whom, at what lifecycle stage, and with what reward construct \- powered by our Intelligence Models and orchestrated through our agentic platform.
   

  

 This is a strategic and technical role that requires equal comfort with game design frameworks, ML\-powered personalization, and financial sustainability modeling. You will work closely with applied scientists, software engineers, marketing stakeholders, and category teams to ship experiences that delight hundreds of millions of customers while driving settlement across India, Mexico, Brazil, Turkey, Saudi Arabia, UAE, Australia, Singapore, and South Africa.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 Define and drive the 3\-year product vision for Gamified Experiences across all emerging locales
   

  

 Own the P\&L for gamification programs \- including advertiser funding models
   

  

 Ship milestone\-based rewards, missions, and progression systems that measurably improve customer settlement metrics
   

  

 Build and maintain the gamification configuration platform (Rewards Console) enabling self\-service challenge creation by category and marketing teams
   

  

 Partner with Applied Science on challenge selection algorithms, reward denomination optimization, and customer journey orchestration
   

  

 Drive weekly operating cadence with marketing, category advertisers, and BizOps to design, launch, and audit challenge constructs
   

  

 Establish always\-on gamification programs (vs. campaign\-based) that build long\-term customer habits and brand perception
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Lifecycle Experiences team is on a mission to deepen customer engagement across Amazon's fastest\-growing marketplaces. We own the end\-to\-end customer lifecycle \- from first purchase to habitual shopping \- across India, Mexico, Brazil, Turkey, Saudi Arabia, UAE, Australia, Singapore, and South Africa. Our north star is moving customers from occasional buyers to loyal, high\-frequency shoppers.
   

  

 We build and scale programs including Gamified Experiences, Rewards, Promotions Orchestration, and Personalization \- reaching millions of customers across our fast growing marketplaces. We operate at the intersection of product, marketing, and data science, and we move fast.

jobs.title: Advanced Business Analyst I-OMP
jobs.description:
Organization: Novo Nordisk Global Business Services (GBS)
   

  

 Shape the future of planning systems that ensure life\-saving medicines reach patients worldwide.
   

  

**Your new role**
 As an Advanced Business Analyst I \- OMP , you'll be the go\-to specialist for our advanced planning solutions, working with our Supply Chain Optimization tool, OMP. This is a role where your technical expertise directly impacts our ability to plan, produce, and deliver medicines to millions of patients globally.
   

  

**Day\-to\-day Your Tasks Will Include**
* Key member of the maintenance \& support of our enterprise\-wide Planning Systems with a focus on OMP and SAP integration
* Managing change, release, and incident support while ensuring smooth configuration management and test coordination
* Driving simplification initiatives by analyzing and implementing improvements across planning processes
* Collaborating with stakeholders across EIT \& Line of Business organizations, convincing diverse audiences to adopt new concepts and approaches
* Mentoring and coaching colleagues within your area of speciality, setting direction for cross\-functional teams
* Working closely with external vendors, particularly OMP, managing relationships across multiple geographies and time zones
* Participating in agile team events and driving incremental innovation to support continuous improvement


**Your new department**
 In Enterprise IT \& Quality, you will be part of a business area that drives impact across the full Novo Nordisk value chain. We strive to stay close to our stakeholders in the business to ensure we deliver on their needs, helping reach millions of people living with serious chronic diseases. Our focus is on being at the forefront within our area; ensuring the highest quality for patients, being a trusted tech leader and an environmentally responsible business.
   

  

 Within Enterprise IT \& Quality, you'll join LIMS, Planning \& Ecosystems – the unit responsible for Enterprise\-wide Laboratory, Planning and related IT systems at Novo Nordisk. Our systems are used on a global scale across business areas and are critical to the execution of key business processes. Your role will be central to ensuring these mission\-critical systems operate seamlessly.
   

  

**Your Skills \& Qualifications**
 We're looking for an experienced OMP specialist who thrives in a global, cross\-functional environment. You'll bring with you:
   

  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree with relevant technological and domain experience
* 9\-10 years of experience with IT project work, or 7\-9 years covering specification, design, development, operations and maintenance of IT solutions
* Hands\-on experience with OMP and SAP, preferably across cross\-geographical, large\-scale projects
* Experience across planning processes including supply planning, capacity planning and detailed scheduling
* Practical knowledge of key OMP functionalities, configuration, testing, data handling and integration between OMP \& SAP
* Strong stakeholder and vendor management skills in a global setup, with the ability to present complex solutions to different management layers
* Proactive, finisher personality with the ability to work independently while fostering team spirit and knowledge sharing
* Fluency in English (oral and written) with cross\-cultural awareness and understanding
* Pharmaceutical industry experience and familiarity with Agile, DevOps and validation/regulatory requirements is desirable


**Working at Novo Nordisk**
 Every day we seek the solutions that defeat serious chronic diseases. To do this, we approach our work with determination, constant curiosity and a commitment to finding better ways forward. For over 100 years, this dedication has driven us to build a company focused on lasting change for long\-term health. One where diverse thinking, shared purpose and mutual respect come together to create extraordinary results. Here, your technical expertise translates into meaningful impact – ensuring our advanced planning systems enable us to deliver life\-saving medicines to patients who need them. When you join us, you're not just starting a job – you're becoming part of a story that spans generations.
   

  

**What We Offer**
 There is, of course, more on offer here than the uniqueness of our culture and the extraordinary results we produce. Being part of a global healthcare company means opportunities to learn and develop are all around us, while our benefits are designed with your career and life stage in mind.
   

  

 We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.
   

  

 At Novo Nordisk, we're not chasing quick fixes – we're creating lasting change for long\-term health. For over 100 years, we've been driven by a single purpose: to defeat serious chronic diseases and help millions of people live healthier lives. This dedication fuels our constant curiosity and inspires us to push the boundaries of what's possible in healthcare. We embrace diverse perspectives, seek out bold ideas, and build partnerships rooted in shared purpose. Together, we're making healthcare more accessible, treating and preventing diseases, and pioneering solutions that create change spanning generations. When you join us, you become part of something bigger – a legacy of impact that reaches far beyond today.
